data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 1.138 million in 2021, primarily driven by adverse development on the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years. Key contributors to this strengthening included significant losses from the 2020 underwriting year, notably winter storm Uri (GBP 13.2 million gross impact on prior years), Hurricane Ida (GBP 7.5 million gross impact on prior years), and an GBP 8.2 million gross increase in COVID-19 loss reserves affecting the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years. Other adverse developments on 2020 losses included Measat (GBP 0.4 million) and the Iowa derecho (GBP 2.3 million).

data.data_quality_notes: The opening reserves figure from the Balance Sheet (GBP 142.225m) differs slightly from the "At 1 January 2021" figure in Note 14 (GBP 144.225m). The Balance Sheet figure was used as the primary source. Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle, as no explicit gross prior year movement note was found. The narrative mentions specific events contributing to prior year losses, but not a total gross figure.
